subject.title: Feature Request: Add 'description' field to agent config for dynamic agent discovery

question: Should configured nonblank `agents.list[].description` values be visible through the authorized, model-facing `agents_list` tool response?
rationale: Current main already accepts the config field, but returning it to agents changes the model-visible discovery contract and may expose operator-authored metadata.

options.title: Accept Description Exposure
options.body: Approve the boundary and finish the linked PR after branch refresh and normal gates.

options.title: Gate Or Narrow Output
options.body: Require the linked PR to restrict which callers or fields can see descriptions before merge.

options.title: Reject This Surface
options.body: Keep descriptions as config-only metadata and ask for a broader roster or prompt-context design instead.

recommendation.title: Accept Description Exposure
recommendation.body: Approve the boundary and finish the linked PR after branch refresh and normal gates.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history signal on the current `agents_list` and multi-agent runtime surfaces.
